scientific_integrity: Proof via exact primitive-idempotent classification, perpendicular norm equations, hyperbolic decomposition and all-characteristic-odd Gauss sums; independent literal target-fiber enumeration in prime and degree-two extension fields. Finite checks are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Nondegenerate spin factors over finite fields of odd order, dimension at least two; ordered primitive-idempotent pair products only. Dimension-two Jordan symmetric-matrix Peirce incidence and associative rank-one matrix products are related but different established problems. Not independently audited.
title: Exact primitive-idempotent Jordan-product fibers and a sharp dimension-four saturation threshold
